import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

print("=" * 70)
print("8-SEED MATCHED PAIRED DELTA: Adaptive vs VLA-only")

sp_delta = [a-v for a,v in zip(sp_adapt, sp_vla)]
sp_t, sp_p = stats.ttest_1samp(sp_delta, 0)

print(f"\nSPATIAL ({len(sp_seeds)} matched seeds: s{sp_seeds[0]}-s{sp_seeds[-1]})")
print(f"  Adaptive:  {np.mean(sp_adapt):.2f} ± {np.std(sp_adapt, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  VLA-only:  {np.mean(sp_vla):.2f} ± {np.std(sp_vla, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  Δ (mean):  {np.mean(sp_delta):+.2f}pp ± {np.std(sp_delta, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  Per-seed Δ: {[f'{d:+.1f}' for d in sp_delta]}")
print(f"  Paired t={sp_t:.3f}, p={sp_p:.4f} {'✅ *' if sp_p<0.05 else '❌ ns'}")
print(f"  95% CI: [{np.mean(sp_delta)-stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(sp_delta)-1)*np.std(sp_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(sp_delta)):.2f}, {np.mean(sp_delta)+stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(sp_delta)-1)*np.std(sp_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(sp_delta)):.2f}]")

print(f"\nGOAL ({len(go_seeds)} matched seeds: s42-s49)")
print(f"  Adaptive:  {np.mean(go_adapt):.2f} ± {np.std(go_adapt, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  VLA-only:  {np.mean(go_vla):.2f} ± {np.std(go_vla, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  Δ (mean):  {np.mean(go_delta):+.2f}pp ± {np.std(go_delta, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  Per-seed Δ: {[f'{d:+.1f}' for d in go_delta]}")
print(f"  Paired t={go_t:.3f}, p={go_p:.4f} {'✅ *' if go_p<0.05 else '❌ ns'}")
print(f"  95% CI: [{np.mean(go_delta)-stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(go_delta)-1)*np.std(go_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(go_delta)):.2f}, {np.mean(go_delta)+stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(go_delta)-1)*np.std(go_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(go_delta)):.2f}]")

# OBJECT (8 matched seeds: s42-s49)
ob_seeds = [42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 49]
ob_adapt = [81.0, 77.5, 75.0, 78.0, 77.5, 77.0, 76.0, 74.0]

print(f"  Δ (mean):  {np.mean(ob_delta):+.2f}pp ± {np.std(ob_delta, ddof=1):.2f}")
print(f"  Per-seed Δ: {[f'{d:+.1f}' for d in ob_delta]}")
print(f"  Paired t={ob_t:.3f}, p={ob_p:.4f} {'✅ *' if ob_p<0.05 else '❌ ns'}")
print(f"  95% CI: [{np.mean(ob_delta)-stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(ob_delta)-1)*np.std(ob_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(ob_delta)):.2f}, {np.mean(ob_delta)+stats.t.ppf(0.975,len(ob_delta)-1)*np.std(ob_delta,ddof=1)/np.sqrt(len(ob_delta)):.2f}]")

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)
for name, delta, p in [("Spatial", sp_delta, sp_p), ("Goal", go_delta, go_p), ("Object", ob_delta, ob_p)]:
